courses.overview: 從資料最小化與隱私效用權衡延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend data minimization and privacy–utility trade-offs to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

related.title: 差分隱私查詢服務
related.why: 兩者都區分隱私與效用
related.transfer: 兩者都區分隱私與效用
related.difference: 查詢服務需正式鄰接與預算會計
related.differenceEn: Query services need formal adjacency and budget accounting

place.name: NIST 研究城市代表點
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「差分隱私查詢服務」共用的資料／元件介面；以「兩者都區分隱私與效用」指出能保留的條件。
針對「查詢服務需正式鄰接與預算會計」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with differentially private query services; use "Both distinguish privacy from utility" to identify retained conditions.
For "Query services need formal adjacency and budget accounting", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

courses.summary: 隱私保護資料分析從資料最小化與隱私效用權衡連結介面、資料與驗收。地圖是公開研究城市的近似代表點，不代表所有工具在此製造或部署。
courses.summaryEn: Privacy-preserving data analytics connects interfaces, data and acceptance through data minimization and privacy–utility trade-offs. Maps are approximate public research-city references, not claims of manufacturing or deployment.
courses.connection: 從「用途邊界」到「效用決策」，將技術定義與可反駁驗證對接。
courses.connectionEn: Connect purpose boundaries to utility decisions, pairing technical definitions and falsifiable validation.

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: 隱私工程同時處理資料用途與量化保證；NIST 框架與 SP 800-226 支援兩個不同層次。
history.textEn: Privacy engineering addresses purpose and quantitative guarantees; the NIST framework and SP 800-226 support these different layers.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration
history.title: 跨機構、跨版本的工程驗證
history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.
